propositions.name: ether_exists_as_medium
propositions.statement: There exists an ether that occupies the space between moving matter and can be disturbed or dragged by it.
propositions.quote: no first-order effect of purely irrotational etherial motion can ever be optically detected

propositions.name: ether_has_definite_motion
propositions.statement: The ether is either stationary or carried along by moving matter, and its motion is a definite matter.
propositions.quote: such messes of matter as we had been dealing with are incompetent to disturb the ether in e rotational manner

propositions.name: motion_relative_to_ether_meaningful
propositions.statement: Motion of the light and observer relatively to the ether would produce a definite effect on the bands.
propositions.quote: a motion of the light and observer would produce an effect, since they would be moving relatively to the ether.

propositions.name: time_of_journey_perfectly_definite
propositions.statement: The time of journey of light along any given path through any kind of material is perfectly definite and independent of the motion of the material.
propositions.quote: the time of journey along any given path through any kind of material is likewise perfectly definite, and independent of the motion

propositions.name: velocity_of_light_between_plates_definite
propositions.statement: The velocity of light between two plates moving together in their own plane is a definite quantity that could be increased or diminished by the plates' velocity.
propositions.quote: The velocity of light between two steel plates moving together in their own plane, an inch apart, is not increased or diminished by so much as

propositions.name: galilean_addition_of_light_and_matter
propositions.statement: If the ether were dragged by the moving plates, the velocity of light through the space between them would be increased or diminished by a fraction of the plates' velocity.
propositions.quote: not increased or diminished by so much as

propositions.name: bifurcated_beam_in_two_directions
propositions.statement: A beam of light can be bifurcated so its two halves travel in opposite directions round the space between moving disks and be observed to interfere.
propositions.quote: the effect of the motion on a bifurcated beam of light, whose two halves travelled in opposite directions several times round in the space between the disks, was observed.

propositions.name: band_shift_measures_path_difference
propositions.statement: A shift of the central band of the interference system by a small fraction of a band width measures a difference in the paths or times of the two half beams.
propositions.quote: a shift of the central band of the system by so much as the hundredth part of the width of a band could be observed.

propositions.name: reversible_shift_diagnoses_ether_effect
propositions.statement: A shift of the bands that reverses with the direction of spin shows a true ether effect, while an irreversible shift shows a spurious disturbing cause.
propositions.quote: It repeated itself each time without regard to the direction of spin, and disappeared, though not instantly, when the disks stopped.

propositions.name: ether_may_possess_viscosity
propositions.statement: The ether may possess a trace of something akin to viscosity by which the medium could be got hold of by moving matter.
propositions.quote: unless there existed a trace of something akin to viscosity by which the medium could be got hold of

propositions.name: mass_may_drag_ether_gravitationally
propositions.statement: Matter may drag the ether with it in proportion to its mass, through an unknown kind of connexion akin to gravitation.
propositions.quote: If matter conceivably drags the ether with it in proportion to its mass, an ordinary lump of matter can hardly be expected to cope with the heart

propositions.name: magnetic_field_may_grip_ether
propositions.statement: A magnetic field carried by moving matter might confer upon it the power of gripping and rotationally carrying the ether.
propositions.quote: the conveyance of a magnetic field by moving matter confers; no power of gripping the ether

propositions.name: electric_charge_may_grip_ether
propositions.statement: Electric charge on moving matter might confer upon a material body some power of gripping and rotationally carrying forward the ether in a quasi-viscous manner.
propositions.quote: electric charge, being as it were the connexion between ether and matter, might confer upon a material body some power of gripping and rotationally carrying forward the ether in a quasi-viscous manner.

propositions.name: earth_may_carry_ether
propositions.statement: It is a question whether the ether near the earth is stationary or is carried round or along by that body.
propositions.quote: If the ether is stationary near the earth, that is, if it be neither carried round nor along by that body

propositions.name: earth_rotation_shifts_bands
propositions.statement: The earth's rotation through a stationary ether would produce a shift of the bands proportional to the area of the interference square.
propositions.quote: a single interference square, 1 kilometre in the side, would show a shift of rather more than one band width

propositions.name: observer_frame_independent_of_earth
propositions.statement: To observe terrestrial ether drift the observer and his apparatus must be made independent of the earth's rotation.
propositions.quote: unless some method could be devised of making the observer and his apparatus independent of the rotation.

propositions.name: turntable_rotation_shifts_bands
propositions.statement: Rotating the whole apparatus, telescope, and observer on a turntable through a stationary ether would produce a reversible shift of the bands.
propositions.quote: the whole apparatus, lantern, optical frame, telescope, observer and all were mounted on a turntable and caused to rotate, a reversible shift of the bands should be seen.

propositions.name: beams_return_after_many_reflexions
propositions.statement: Two half beams of light that have undergone many reflexions and transmissions through panes of glass return to a common plate and interfere.
propositions.quote: each half of the beam had to undergo not only 11 reflexions as usual, before returning to the semi-transparent plate, but also 24 transmissions through panes of glass

propositions.name: drag_may_accumulate_with_time
propositions.statement: Any effect of moving matter on the ether might develop or increase with time of continued rotation.
propositions.quote: kept the disks spinning for three hours at 1900 revolutions, to see if any shift developed with time.

propositions.name: band_shift_depends_on_speed_and_path
propositions.statement: The observable band shift depends on the refractive index of the air, the angular speed of the disks, and the number of light-journeys round the optical square.
propositions.quote: must be 300, in order to show the air effect, that is, the speed must rise to 6000 revolutions a minute with a light-journey of three times round.

propositions.name: refractive_index_proportional_to_density
propositions.statement: The quantity μ − 1 for air is proportional to the density ρ of the air.
propositions.quote: The gradation of density could therefore cause a distinct effect if the beam of light had an odd number of paths between the disks

propositions.name: centrifugal_density_gradient_causes_shift
propositions.statement: The gradation of air density from centrifugal force during rotation can account for part of the residual irreversible shift observable at high speeds.
propositions.quote: This cause may therefore account for part of the residual irreversible shift observable at high speeds, when all kinds of mechanical and thermal disturbance have been apparently eliminated.

propositions.name: absence_of_shift_implies_no_drag
propositions.statement: Absence of a reversible shift of the bands when moving matter is spun demonstrates that neither electric nor magnetic field enables moving matter to grip and move the ether rotationally.
propositions.quote: neither an electric nor a magnetic transverse field confers viscosity upon the ether, nor enables moving matter to grip and move it rotationally.

propositions.name: irrotational_motion_undetectable_by_optics
propositions.statement: Irrotational motion of a single-valued kind in a medium cannot be detected by interference or any other optical experiment.
propositions.quote: irrotational motion of a single-valued kind could not be detected by interference or any other optical experiments, since such motion in no way effects either the path or the speed of a ray

propositions.name: half_beams_interfere_in_common_eyepiece
propositions.statement: The two half beams are made to interfere in the field of view of a micrometer eye-piece where a shift of the central band can be observed.
propositions.quote: The two half beams were made to interfere in the field of view of a micrometer eye-piece

propositions.name: concertina_action_distinct_from_shift
propositions.statement: A concertina action, a moving of the lateral bands in or out from the central one as the speed varied, is a phenomenon distinct from a shift of the middle band.
propositions.quote: still the bands showed, what we call a concertina action, that is, a slight moving of the lateral bands in or out from the central one, as the speed varied.

propositions.name: disturbing_causes_traceable_and_eliminable
propositions.statement: Disturbing causes such as blast, heat, and vibration can be traced and eliminated so as not to be mistaken for the true ether effect.
propositions.quote: any effect of that magnitude would be certainly masked by the residual slight disturbing causes present.

propositions.name: single_valued_potential_no_ray_effect
propositions.statement: As long as the motion of a medium is characterised by a single-valued potential function, the course of observable rays through it is independent of the motion.
propositions.quote: as long as the motion of a medium is characterised everywhere by a single-valued potential function, the course of all observable rays through it, however reflected and refracted they may be, is independent of the motion
